02 / WHY WE GATHER

Research in practice
Every detail welcome

A conversation among researchers doing the work. Share how an idea took shape, the opportunity you saw, and how you solved the problem. Bring the decisions and practical steps your peers can build on.

01

How the idea took shape

Why was the problem worth tackling? Where did the idea come from, and what opportunity did you see? Explain where existing methods fell short, how you framed the problem, and why you chose your approach.

IDEAS & OPPORTUNITIES
02

How you built and tuned the model

Walk through the architecture, data preparation, and loss function. Share how you chose and tuned the learning rate and batch size, along with experimental settings, baselines, and implementation details.

MODELS & EXPERIMENTS
03

How you debugged and iterated

How did you trace an error, diagnose a run that would not converge, or investigate an unexpected result? Share what you checked, the attempts that failed, and the changes that worked. Make room for peers to ask about every step.

DEBUGGING & ITERATION

A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

Before you join

Who is this series for?

A forum centered on young researchers in AI for Science, open to students, researchers, and practitioners who want to discuss methods and exchange experience. Any suggested background will be listed with each session.

When and how do sessions take place?

Topics, speakers, dates, and joining details are posted on this website as they are confirmed, with updates on SciMindBin on WeChat. Follow the website or select the WeChat icon to scan the QR code. Every session includes live discussion, with no recordings or replays.

Will there be recordings or replays?

No. Sessions are never recorded and no replays are provided. We also ask participants not to record. Past pages retain only the topic and speaker information. Join live, ask questions, and take useful experience back to your research.

How can I recommend a speaker or support the series?

Recommend an active researcher, or put yourself forward. Send the speaker’s name, research area, proposed topic, and relevant links to bincao@hkust-gz.edu.cn. The inviter also hosts the session. For collaboration or sponsorship, email the same address with how you would like to contribute.
